datasetTitle: Administrative boundaries — basic level, S-JTSK03 GeoPackage

municipalityCrosswalk.authority: Statistical Office of the Slovak Republic territorial division

derivationNotes: The archive and extracted GeoPackage were hash-verified before read-only extraction.
Only numeric IDN3 values 802, 803, 804, and 805 from okres_0 were selected.
The source coordinates are copied from the GeoPackage geometry blobs as binary64 coordinate values and serialized with round-trip decimal precision.
No source reprojection, simplification, repair, or display-name selection was performed.
The municipal code crosswalk identifies the owner-selected Košice administrative product boundary; it does not establish lighting-operator asset responsibility.
